title: Pontotoc County unemployment rises to 3.8% in October
excerpt: Pontotoc’s jobless rate rose for the second straight month and was above the statewide rate of 3.6%. The county’s October labor force numbered 11,833.
locality: Pontotoc County and adjacent Chickasaw, Lee, Union and Lafayette counties in Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County’s unemployment rate rose to 3.8% in October, up from 3.4% in September. The Mississippi Department of Employment Security’s monthly county figures show a second straight increase after August’s 3.2%.

The county’s rate ran two-tenths of a percentage point above Mississippi’s 3.6%. The figures in that comparison are both unadjusted for seasonal changes. The state’s October labor force map lists 11,833 Pontotoc County residents in the civilian labor force, which includes employed people and those counted as unemployed.

Neighboring counties fell on both sides of Pontotoc’s rate. Chickasaw County recorded 4.4%, while Lee County was at 3.4%, Union County at 3.1% and Lafayette County at 3.0%. All four figures are for October.
